description: This file implements the StorageManager class for managing storage operations such as create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage for applications within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes methods for configuration, storage management, and interaction with a RequestHandler singleton.

classes.name: StorageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Class providing storage management functionalities such as create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage for applications, with configuration and initialization routines.

methods.name: ~StorageManagerImplementation
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and releasing references.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the storage manager with the provided service, setting up paths and internal state.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified app ID and size, returning the storage path.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage information and location for a given app ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a given app ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specified app ID.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all storage except for exempted app IDs.
